notes: gemma detection prompt: 'Detect the 2d bounding boxes of the Visible Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Fruit/Flower, Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower. Output a JSON list where each entry contains the 2D bounding box in "box_2d" and a text label in "label" (one of: Visible Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Fruit/Flower, Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower). The box_2d coordinates are [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max], normalized to 0-1000.'. Generation sampling params (vLLM): {'temperature': 1.0, 'top_p': 0.95, 'top_k': 64}, max_tokens=2048, batch_size=32. Box predictions are normalized to a 0-1000 grid (BOX_SCALE=1000) relative to the original image and rescaled to pixel coordinates before matching (see detections_to_prediction). precision_at_iou50/recall_at_iou50/f1_at_iou50 come from greedy same-class box matching at IoU>=0.5 (see match_detections); no mAP is computed since neither model emits a per-box confidence score to rank predictions by.

qwen detection prompt: 'Locate every instance of the Visible Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Fruit/Flower, Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower in the image. Output a JSON list where each entry contains the bounding box in "bbox_2d" and a text label in "label" (one of: Visible Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Fruit/Flower, Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower, Partially Visible Occluded Fruit/Flower). The bbox_2d coordinates are [x1, y1, x2, y2], normalized to 0-1000.'. Generation sampling params (vLLM): {'temperature': 1.0, 'top_p': 0.95, 'top_k': 20, 'min_p': 0.0, 'presence_penalty': 0.0, 'repetition_penalty': 1.0}, max_tokens=2048, batch_size=32. Box predictions are normalized to a 0-1000 grid (BOX_SCALE=1000) relative to the original image and rescaled to pixel coordinates before matching (see detections_to_prediction). Vision-tower input resolution (orthogonal to box coordinates) used min_pixels=784, max_pixels=78400000, factor=32 (see resolve_image_processor_config). precision_at_iou50/recall_at_iou50/f1_at_iou50 come from greedy same-class box matching at IoU>=0.5 (see match_detections); no mAP is computed since neither model emits a per-box confidence score to rank predictions by.

Evaluated on the full train split (50 images): it is within the 500-image sampling cap, so no subsampling was applied. OWLv2 detection prompt: one text query per dataset category name. Images larger than twice the model's input side are downscaled before preprocessing; boxes are rescaled to the original image size before scoring. No score threshold is applied: every predicted box is a candidate for every label, and the top 100 boxes per label per image are kept. mAP is COCO-style mAP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.95 and mAP50 is AP at IoU 0.50 (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision, bbox).

Evaluated on the full train split (50 images): it is within the 500-image sampling cap, so no subsampling was applied. Grounding DINO detection prompt: the dataset's category names, lowercased and joined into a single caption "name1. name2. ..."; each box's score for a label is the max sigmoid score over that label's caption tokens. No score threshold is applied: every predicted box is a candidate for every label, and the top 100 boxes per label per image are kept. mAP is COCO-style mAP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.95 and mAP50 is AP at IoU 0.50 (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision, bbox).
